prompt: An old man warned me (not / to run) near that big black dog.
explanation_ru: После глагола warn с дополнением (me) используется инфинитив с частицей to, а отрицание not всегда ставится перед to: warned me not to run.

prompt: My uncle told us (to wash) our hands before touching the baby rabbits.
explanation_ru: В косвенных указаниях и приказах после tell + дополнение (us) ставится инфинитив с частицей to: told us to wash.

prompt: Minho asked his friend (to hold) his ticket while he found their seats.
explanation_ru: Для передачи просьбы используется модель ask + дополнение (his friend) + to-инфинитив: asked his friend to hold.

prompt: Our teacher told the class (not / to touch) the old printing machines.
explanation_ru: Чтобы передать запрет через tell, частица not ставится строго перед to: told the class not to touch.

prompt: Did the museum guard ask you (to step) back from those photos?
explanation_ru: Даже в вопросительном предложении после ask + дополнение (you) для просьбы требуется инфинитив с частицей to.

prompt: Strong wind hit the lake, so Father ordered me (to tie) the boat.
explanation_ru: Глагол order (приказать) в косвенной речи требует дополнения и инфинитива с to: ordered me to tie.

prompt: At the space museum, the guide reminded us (to stay) behind the yellow line.
explanation_ru: Глагол remind в значении «напомнить кому-то что-то сделать» используется по схеме remind + дополнение + to-инфинитив.

prompt: My flatmate warned me (not / to leave) the pan on high heat, or the garlic would burn.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное предупреждение после warn + дополнение строится через not to + глагол, а не to not.

prompt: Before the night train departed, a station officer advised Lukas (to keep) his phone inside his zipped pocket.
explanation_ru: Когда после advise указано лицо (Lukas), далее обязательно идёт инфинитив с to: advised Lukas to keep.

prompt: When two elephants walked past the jeep, the ranger told everyone (to sit) still and (not / to shout).
explanation_ru: После told everyone оба однородных указания передаются инфинитивом с to; во втором случае отрицание not ставится перед to.

prompt: The interviewer asked Nadia (to describe) her previous job in one minute, yet she spoke about her cat instead.
explanation_ru: Здесь передаётся просьба выполнить действие, поэтому после asked Nadia нужен to-инфинитив, а не придаточное с that.

prompt: Because the lift was out of order, the shop manager begged the delivery team (to carry) the sofa to the third floor.
explanation_ru: Глагол beg (умолять) в косвенной просьбе требует конструкции beg + дополнение + to-инфинитив.

prompt: Why did the support agent ask you (to clear) your browser and (to reload) the payment page?
explanation_ru: После ask you ставится to-инфинитив (to clear); во втором однородном глаголе после and частицу to можно как сохранить, так и опустить.

prompt: On his first evening at the cinema in Izmir, Deniz warned the new assistant (never / to open) the film box while the engine was running.
explanation_ru: Как и частица not, наречие never при инфинитиве в косвенном предупреждении ставится строго перед to: warned ... never to open.

prompt: Inside the cold seed store in Oslo, the keeper urgently reminded the courier (to place) all the packets in the freezer before the heavy door locked.
explanation_ru: В контексте напоминания о необходимом действии после reminded + дополнение (the courier) используется to-инфинитив.

prompt: Handing out the reading list at the student hall, Ingrid advised the newcomers (not / to delay) their essays until the final night before the deadline.
explanation_ru: Отрицательный совет после advise + дополнение передаётся формой not to + глагол, без союза that и без вспомогательного глагола.

prompt: After a fake note had turned up in a neighbouring shop, Leila warned the cashiers (to check) all banknotes twice and (not / to rush) during busy hours.
explanation_ru: Оба предупреждения зависят от warned the cashiers: сначала идёт утвердительный to-инфинитив, затем отрицательный — not to rush.

prompt: Break time ended at our school in Colombo. The teacher clapped her hands loudly. She told us (to line) up by the door at once. Then she warned Ravi (not / to kick) the ball near the windows.
explanation_ru: После told us ставится утвердительный инфинитив to line, а в запрете после warned Ravi отрицание not идёт перед to (not to kick).

prompt: We played a badminton match in Kuala Lumpur. Our coach watched quietly from the side. First, he (to ask / us / to count) the points out loud. Later, he (to invite / me / to join) the Friday team.
explanation_ru: Оба глагола (ask и invite) в прошедшем повествовании ставятся в Past Simple и требуют прямого дополнения без предлога to плюс to-инфинитив.

prompt: It was lunchtime at a busy café in Paris. The manager tapped the counter and looked straight at Mateo. He ordered the new waiter (to clean) table six at once and bring fresh menus to the door. Then he asked Mateo (he / to know) the soup of the day. Mateo simply froze with a cloth in his hand.
explanation_ru: Приказ после ordered передаётся через to-инфинитив (to clean), а общий вопрос после asked — через if/whether с прямым порядком слов и сдвигом времени в Past Simple.

prompt: Rain cleared before the rock band walked onto the stage in Belgium. A friendly steward stopped our group near the front speakers. She advised us (to wear) earplugs during the loud set. She also warned us (not / to put) our phones in back pockets. Finally, she (to remind / everyone / to keep) their tickets ready for the exit check.
explanation_ru: После advised и reminded используется to-инфинитив (to wear, reminded everyone to keep), а в отрицательном предупреждении not ставится перед to (not to put).

prompt: A bright green parrot arrived at the pet hotel in Munich. Its owner left a long note at the front desk. She (to tell / the staff / to feed) the bird fresh apple slices twice a day. She also warned the receptionist (never / to leave) the cage door unlocked. At the end of the note, she asked (anyone / to speak) Spanish to the parrot.

blanks.cue: to tell / the staff / to feed

explanation_ru: Инструкция и запрет передаются через tell/warn + дополнение + (never) to-инфинитив, а заключительный общий вопрос — через asked if/whether со сдвигом в Past Simple.

prompt: Dusk fell quickly over our camp in Namibia. Petrus, the park ranger, walked past the tents with a torch. He (to ask / us / to lock) our food boxes inside the car. He also warned everyone (not / to drop) any fruit peel near the sleeping bags. Nobody argued after hearing wild dogs beyond the fence.
explanation_ru: Для просьбы используется asked us to lock (без предлога to перед us), а для предупреждения — отрицательный инфинитив not to drop.

prompt: Tension filled the computer lab in Santiago before the final exam. The strict technician marched between the desks with a clipboard. First, he (to order / the students / to switch) off all mobile phones and place them face down. Next, he warned anyone with a smart watch (not / to glance) at their wrist during the test. Even so, a loud ringtone broke the silence ten minutes later, and the technician calmly asked the red-faced student (the phone / to belong) to him.

blanks.cue: to order / the students / to switch

explanation_ru: Приказ и запрет строятся через order/warn + дополнение + (not) to-инфинитив, тогда как в финале глагол ask вводит косвенный вопрос с if/whether и формой Past Simple.

prompt: Bright lights heated the television cooking studio in Seoul five minutes before airtime. The floor manager gathered the three nervous guests behind the counter. She (to advise / them / to speak) one at a time so the microphones could pick up each voice clearly. Then she reminded the youngest guest, Ji-hoon, (not / to stare) at the monitor above the stove. Moments before the countdown started, the host invited the audience (to clap) loudly on his signal.
explanation_ru: Глаголы advise, remind и invite объединены моделью «глагол + дополнение + (not) to-инфинитив», где частица not при отрицании стоит перед to.

prompt: Moving into my first flat in Vancouver felt exciting until the landlord rushed me with the paperwork. Thankfully, Mum sent a long email packed with practical tips. She (to urge / me / to test) all the radiators before signing the rent agreement. In the second paragraph, she warned me (not / to pay) any deposit in cash without a signed receipt. Finally, she offered (to drive) over at the weekend with spare curtains and a kettle.
explanation_ru: Глаголы urge и warn требуют дополнения перед (not) to-инфинитивом (urged me to test, warned me not to pay), тогда как offer в значении «предложить свою помощь» присоединяет to-инфинитив напрямую.

prompt: During the school visit in Manila, the dentist ___ the back teeth slowly.
options: told the children brush
said the children to brush
told the children to brush
told to the children to brush
explanation_ru: Правильная модель — tell + дополнение без предлога to + to-инфинитив (told the children to brush). Типичные ошибки — пропуск to, лишнее to после tell или замена tell на say.

prompt: At Singapore airport, a security officer ___ my laptop into the plastic tray.
options: asked me to put
asked me that I put
asked to me to put
asked me put
explanation_ru: Косвенная просьба строится по схеме ask + дополнение + to-инфинитив (asked me to put). Калька с русского «asked me that I...» и предлог to перед me ошибочны.

prompt: Seeing water all over the floor at the Helsinki pool, the lifeguard ___ on the wet tiles.
options: warned the teenagers to not run
warned the teenagers not to run
warned the teenagers don't run
warned to the teenagers not to run
explanation_ru: В отрицательном предупреждении частица not стоит перед to (not to run). Типичные ошибки — порядок to not, сохранение повелительного don't и лишний предлог to после warned.

prompt: My suitcase nearly slid off the belt after the airline agent in Chicago ___ it onto the scales.
options: said me to lift
told me that I lifted
asked me lifting
asked me to lift
explanation_ru: Просьба передаётся конструкцией ask + дополнение + to-инфинитив (asked me to lift). Глагол say не используется перед дополнением и инфинитивом, а -ing и придаточное с that здесь неверны.

prompt: Leaning across the library desk in Toronto, a senior student quietly ___ her lecture notes to anyone before the final exams.
options: advised the first-year student to not lend
advised to the first-year student not to lend
advised the first-year student not to lend
advised the first-year student that she doesn't lend
explanation_ru: После advise + прямое дополнение отрицательный совет выражается через not to + инфинитив. Ошибочно ставить предлог to после advised, менять порядок на to not или вводить придаточное с that.

prompt: While the desert wind rattled the office windows in Dubai, the site manager ___ the goods lift until the storm passed.
options: ordered the workers not using
ordered the workers not to use
ordered to the workers not to use
said the workers not to use
explanation_ru: Глагол order принимает прямое дополнение без предлога to и инфинитив с частицей not перед to: ordered the workers not to use.

prompt: The coffee farmer warned me to not pick the bright red berries.
answer: The coffee farmer warned me not to pick the bright red berries.
accepted_answers: The coffee farmer warned me not to pick the bright red berries.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — порядок слов to not вместо not to. При отрицательном инфинитиве частица not всегда стоит перед to.

prompt: A road worker in Manchester told to the drivers to turn left.
answer: A road worker in Manchester told the drivers to turn left.
accepted_answers: A road worker in Manchester told the drivers to turn left.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell предлог to перед адресатом не нужен: правильно told the drivers to turn, без лишнего to.

prompt: In the busy Madrid kitchen, the head chef told the trainee taste the soup before serving it.
answer: In the busy Madrid kitchen, the head chef told the trainee to taste the soup before serving it.
accepted_answers: In the busy Madrid kitchen, the head chef told the trainee to taste the soup before serving it.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — пропуск частицы to перед вторым глаголом. После told + дополнение обязательно нужен полный инфинитив to taste.

prompt: Although Timo was wearing bright red trainers, the careers advisor calmly reminded him not to wear them to the interview.
answer: Although Timo was wearing bright red trainers, the careers advisor calmly reminded him not to wear them to the interview.
accepted_answers: Although Timo was wearing bright red trainers, the careers advisor calmly reminded him not to wear them to the interview.
explanation_ru: Предложение полностью верно: после reminded him правильно использован отрицательный инфинитив not to wear.

prompt: The caretaker in Oslo asked the morning joggers that they kept away from the tall metal figures while the grass was wet.
answer: The caretaker in Oslo asked the morning joggers to keep away from the tall metal figures while the grass was wet.
accepted_answers: The caretaker in Oslo asked the morning joggers to keep away from the tall metal figures while the grass was wet.
explanation_ru: В английском языке просьба после ask + дополнение не строится через кальку «that they...»; нужен инфинитив с to: asked the morning joggers to keep away.

prompt: At a street-food market in Kuala Lumpur, our local guide said, "Don't drink the tap water here, and wash your fruit first." Which report is correct?
options: Our guide warned us not to drink the tap water there and to wash our fruit first.
Our guide asked us if we drank the tap water there and washed our fruit first.
Our guide told us to drink the tap water there and not to wash our fruit first.
Our guide warned us that we didn't drink the tap water there and washed our fruit first.
explanation_ru: Прямое предупреждение передаётся через warned us not to drink ... and to wash ..., при этом here меняется на there, а your — на our. Остальные варианты искажают смысл или нарушают конструкцию.

prompt: In a dark Toronto planetarium, the presenter said to a boy in the front row, "Please stop shining your torch at the ceiling." Which sentence reports this accurately?
options: The presenter invited the boy to shine his torch at the ceiling.
The presenter asked the boy if he had stopped shining his torch at the ceiling.
The presenter asked the boy to stop shining his torch at the ceiling.
The presenter told the boy not to stop shining his torch at the ceiling.
explanation_ru: Вежливая просьба со словом please передаётся через asked the boy to stop shining. Вариант с if превращает просьбу в вопрос, а два других меняют смысл на противоположный.

prompt: Thick fog rolled over the trail in Chamonix, and a mountain guide told the hikers, "Whatever happens, do not leave the marked path." A horn echoed far below. Which report matches both the grammar and the meaning?
options: The guide reminded the hikers to leave the marked path as soon as the fog rolled in.
The guide asked the hikers whether they had left the marked path in the thick fog.
The guide warned the hikers to not leave the marked path whatever happened.
The guide warned the hikers not to leave the marked path whatever happened.
explanation_ru: Запрет верно передан через warned the hikers not to leave, а happens сдвинуто в happened. Вариант с to not нарушает порядок частиц, а первые два не соответствуют смыслу.

prompt: Pointing at the wet floor, the ski instructor said to us, "Put your skis in the rack outside the door." → The ski instructor told …
answer: The ski instructor told us to put our skis in the rack outside the door.
accepted_answers: The ski instructor told us to put our skis in the rack outside the door.
explanation_ru: Повелительное наклонение после said to us преобразуется в told us + to-инфинитив, а местоимение your меняется на our.

prompt: Seeing her nephew reach for the stove in Lagos, Auntie Ada said, "Don't touch the pot with a wet cloth, or the steam will burn you." → Auntie Ada warned her nephew …
answer: Auntie Ada warned her nephew not to touch the pot with a wet cloth, or the steam would burn him.
accepted_answers: Auntie Ada warned her nephew not to touch the pot with a wet cloth, or the steam would burn him.
Auntie Ada warned her nephew not to touch the pot with a wet cloth or the steam would burn him.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное предупреждение Don't touch превращается в not to touch, модальный глагол will сдвигается в would, а местоимение you меняется на him.
